name: アトミヨソワカ 蔵前店
why: UNDER-RATED, and the record already knows it — it carries gf_uncited_downgrade {from: 'options'} whose stated condition ('restore once evidence is attached') is now met, alongside a gf_proposed_tier of 'dedicated'. The evidence: the brand's own identity line is 「ヴィーガンスイーツ・グルテンフリースイーツ 米粉菓子」, it states 「米粉を使っているので、小麦アレルギーの方も安心してお召し上がりいただけるおいしい米粉菓子です」, and all 24 published products are rice-flour bakes with no wheat item anywhere on the site. Per the owner's ruling, writing 小麦アレルギー rather than セリアック does not weaken this. 'high' rather than 'dedicated': the operator never states a dedicated facility or equipment separation, uses organic oatmeal of unstated gluten-purity, and co-produces part of the range at an external workshop (ろくえもん) whose handling is undocumented. Those two questions are exactly what REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md's human gate should put to the shop before anything above 'ask' goes live.

name: 松阪牛焼肉M 法善寺店 はなれ (Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M Hozenji Hanare)
why: Own claim on FMGF: 'Advance reservation required for gluten-free dining. All food menu items can be prepared gluten-free upon request', plus a stated cross-contact routine with advance notice; homemade gluten-free soy sauce, ponzu and dipping sauces; the official branch page tags it グルテンフリー. Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree, 14 recent ratings, celiac reviewers 2024–October 2026 reporting no symptoms, the grill changed between GF and gluten dishes, and GF confirmed at the table. 'high' rather than 'dedicated': a shared yakiniku kitchen where regular soy sauce and marinades are in use; one 2025 review of a server bringing non-GF sauces (caught by asking); GF depends on notice when booking. Questions for the restaurant: separate grill nets and tongs every time? Are the marinades for GF orders made separately?

name: 源氏蕎麦 法善寺参道店 (Genji Soba)
why: Own claims (genjisoba.co.jp/menu): hand-made 100% buckwheat soba; tempura 'Made with Buckwheat & Rice Flour' and 'Fried in a Dedicated Gluten-Free Fryer'; GF and vegan on advance request for set courses. Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree, 101 recent ratings, 30 reports of a dedicated GF fryer, GF-marked menu with a celiac section, many celiac 'no symptoms' reports through October 2026. 'high' rather than 'dedicated': FMGF marks it NOT a dedicated facility; regular dipping sauces are in use; several reviewers say the celiac-safe tempura and menu are dinner only; most reviews predate the March 2026 move to the Hōzenji Sandō shop. Questions for the shop: is the dedicated fryer and celiac menu in place at the new shop at lunch too? Is the GF tsuyu made in separate pots?

name: Naki vegan sweets
why: Own claim (naki-vegansweets.com): 「卵・乳製品など動物性の食材を使用せずに厳選した植物性食材で作るヴィーガングルテンフリースイーツの専門店」 — a vegan, gluten-free sweets specialist. Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree, 30 recent ratings, 'Reported to be dedicated gluten-free and celiac friendly', celiac reviewers through October 2026 reporting no symptoms; rice-flour cookies, almond crusts. Open questions before 'dedicated': the shop's claim is product-level, with no facility statement; a January 2026 review found drink oat milk labelled 'may contain gluten'. Ask: is every product and drink ingredient gluten-free, oats included?

name: Gluten-Free Vegan OKONOMIYAKI Vim
why: Own claim: the restaurant's name and official page title, 'Gluten-Free Vegan OKONOMIYAKI Vim' (nothing more is published). Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree, 'Reported to be dedicated gluten-free and celiac friendly', celiac reviewers March–October 2026 calling it entirely gluten-free and coeliac safe; reported dedicated GF fryer and kitchen; GF beer. Weaknesses: no statement from the restaurant beyond its name; the 'vegan' in the name is contradicted by meat and seafood on the menu, so the name alone is not a reliable claim. Ask: are every flour, sauce (okonomiyaki sauce is usually wheat-based), soy sauce and dashi gluten-free? Is anything with gluten ever brought into the kitchen?

name: 松阪牛焼肉M 道頓堀千日前店 (Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M Dotonbori Sennichimae)
why: Own claim (general manager and chef, replying on FMGF, 2026): 'All of our special sauces are completely gluten-free'; a staff member with celiac disease guides GF diners; the official branch page tags it グルテンフリー. Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree, celiac reviewers August–October 2026 — labelled GF soy sauce shown at the table, non-GF set items substituted, no problems reported. 'high' rather than 'dedicated': a shared yakiniku kitchen; one reviewer says it is 'almost completely gf (except soup)'; sister branch Hōzenji Hanare (queued the same day) is the better-documented one. Questions: which soups and sides contain wheat? Separate grill nets for GF orders?

name: Shojin Sushi Minamo
why: Independent first-hand corroboration only: FindMeGlutenFree 'Reported to be dedicated gluten-free and celiac friendly', celiac reviewers 2025–July 2026 calling it 'all gluten free', GF soy sauce and beer. No own claim found (Instagram only, not fetchable), no hours, and the address does not geocode cleanly (GSI 171 m off). Before any upgrade: confirm the shop is open, its hours, and that soy sauce, vinegar and every topping are gluten-free.

name: Vegan Cafe Tsukineko
why: Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree reviewers 2025–October 2026 describe the food menu as entirely gluten-free and vegan except one marked drink; dedicated GF fryer reported; 'sin trazas'. No own claim captured (Instagram only), and FMGF marks it not a dedicated facility, so 'high' rather than 'dedicated'. Ask: which drink contains gluten, and is the kitchen otherwise gluten-free (flours, soy sauce, the gyoza dipping sauce)?

name: W RETREAT CAFE (W Holistic Retreat)
why: Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree 'Reported to be dedicated gluten-free and celiac friendly', celiac reviewers 2025–October 2026 ('The entire menu is gluten free and vegan', GF pizza, pasta, bread, desserts). Own claim is weak: only a #グルテンフリー hashtag on the concept page; the menu page states vegan, not gluten-free. Ask before upgrading: are all flours, soy sauce, miso and soy meat gluten-free, and is anything with wheat used in the kitchen?

name: RE-public by BASE ISLAND KITCHEN
why: Independent first-hand corroboration: FindMeGlutenFree 'Reported to be dedicated gluten-free and celiac friendly', celiac reviewers 2025–October 2026 ('100% gluten free', no symptoms), dedicated GF fryer reported; the owner flags beer as the only non-GF item. No own statement captured (Facebook not fetched). Ask: is beer the only gluten-containing item on the premises, and are the jerk marinade and soy/stock bases gluten-free?
